import numpy as np
import scipy.linalg as la
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)
d = 384
P = np.eye(d) - np.ones((d,d))/d

A, B, Q, K, V, O = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
for l in range(4):
    g = np.asarray(W[f"ln1_w.{l}"],dtype=np.float64)
    for j in range(6):
        h = (l,j)
        sl = slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
        Q[h] = (W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl]*g)@P
        K[h] = (W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl]*g)@P
        V[h] = (W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl]*g)@P
        O[h] = np.asarray(W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl],dtype=np.float64)
        A[h], B[h] = Q[h].T@K[h], O[h]@V[h]

def cos(a,b):
    return float(np.sum(a*b)/(la.norm(a)*la.norm(b)+1e-30))

print("L0 QK matrix cosine similarities")
print(np.round([[cos(A[0,i],A[0,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)],3))
print("L0 OV matrix cosine similarities")
print(np.round([[cos(B[0,i],B[0,j]) for j in range(6)] for i in range(6)],3))

print("\nInduction-style key-composition diagnostics.")
print("For each later head: preceding OV heads with largest trace(A_l B_earlier)/nuclear_norm(A_l B_earlier).")
print("These are matrix signatures, not attention measurements.")
for h in A:
    if h[0] == 0:
        continue
    rows = []
    for e in B:
        if e[0] >= h[0]:
            continue
        # A B = Q^T (K O) V. Nonzero eigenvalues from a 64x64 product.
        mid = K[h]@O[e]
        small = mid@V[e]@Q[h].T
        ev = la.eigvals(small)
        _, rq = la.qr(Q[h].T,mode="economic")
        _, rv = la.qr(V[e].T,mode="economic")
        sv = la.svdvals(rq@mid@rv.T)
        tr = np.trace(small)
        nuclear_ratio = tr/(sv.sum()+1e-30)
        sign = ev.real.sum()/(np.abs(ev).sum()+1e-30)
        strength = la.norm(mid)/(la.norm(K[h])*la.norm(O[e])+1e-30)
        rows.append((nuclear_ratio,e,sign,strength,la.norm(sv)))
    rows.sort(reverse=True)
    print(f"L{h[0]}H{h[1]}: " + "; ".join(
        f"L{e[0]}H{e[1]} trace/nuc={r:.3f} eigsign={s:.3f} overlap={c:.3f} norm={n:.2f}"
        for r,e,s,c,n in rows[:4]))

print("\nL0 joint query/key and value spectra")
qk0 = np.vstack([Q[0,j] for j in range(6)] + [K[0,j] for j in range(6)])
v0 = np.vstack([V[0,j] for j in range(6)])
for name,m in [("QK",qk0),("V",v0),("V_heads1_5",np.vstack([V[0,1],V[0,5]]))]:
    s = la.svdvals(m)
    print(name, "singular values:", np.round(s[:70],3))

_,_,vt = la.svd(np.vstack([V[0,1],V[0,5]]),full_matrices=False)
T = vt[:27].T
print("\nFraction of L0 Q/K/V squared norm in the 27 leading shared value directions of H1,H5")
for j in range(6):
    print(f"L0H{j}",*[f"{name}={la.norm(m@T)**2/la.norm(m)**2:.3f}"
                      for name,m in [("Q",Q[0,j]),("K",K[0,j]),("V",V[0,j])]])
print("\nL0 QK within and outside that value subspace")
R = np.eye(d)-T@T.T
for j in range(6):
    a=A[0,j]
    tt=T.T@a@T
    rr=R@a@R
    print(f"L0H{j}: total={la.norm(a):.3f} tokenblock={la.norm(tt):.3f} otherblock={la.norm(rr):.3f}"
          f" token_sym={cos(tt,tt.T):.3f} other_sym={cos(rr,rr.T):.3f}"
          f" other_eigs={np.round(la.eigvals(rr)[np.argsort(-np.abs(la.eigvals(rr)))[:12]],3)}")

d=384
P=np.eye(d)-np.ones((d,d))/d
g=np.asarray(W["ln1_w.0"],dtype=float)
Q=[];K=[];V=[];O=[];A=[];B=[]
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(64*j,64*j+64)
    q=(W["W_q.0"][sl]*g)@P
    k=(W["W_k.0"][sl]*g)@P
    v=(W["W_v.0"][sl]*g)@P
    o=np.asarray(W["W_o.0"][:,sl],dtype=float)
    Q.append(q);K.append(k);V.append(v);O.append(o)
    A.append(q.T@k);B.append(o@v)

print("Common spectral modes of L0H5 and L0H1")
for label,sel in [("all",np.arange(d)),("gain_gt_0.5",np.flatnonzero(g>.5))]:
    a=A[5][np.ix_(sel,sel)]

    ev,vl,vr=la.eig(a,left=True,right=True)
    print(label,"dimensions",len(sel))
    for ix in np.argsort(-np.abs(ev)):
        if ev[ix].imag<=1e-5 or abs(ev[ix])<0.08: continue
        r=vr[:,ix]; ll=vl[:,ix]

        print("H5eig",np.round(ev[ix],3),"H1projection",np.round(z,3),
              "phases",round(np.angle(ev[ix]),3),round(np.angle(z),3),"H1_collinearity",round(align,3))

    print("threshold",threshold,"component sizes",[len(ix) for ix in big])
    if threshold != .9: continue
    centers=[]
    for ix in big[:35]:
        center=unit[ix].mean(axis=0);center/=la.norm(center)
        centers.append(center)
        out=np.asarray(W["W_proj.0"][:,ix],dtype=float)
        os=la.svdvals(out)
        print("members",ix[:14],"count",len(ix),"input_norm_median",round(float(np.median(fn[ix])),3),
              "input_coherence",round(float(la.norm(unit[ix].mean(axis=0))),3),
              "output_norm",round(float(la.norm(out)),3),"output_rank1_fraction",round(float(os[0]**2/(os@os)),3),
              "pos_gain_energy",round(float(np.sum(center[g>.5]**2)),3))
    if centers:
        centers=np.array(centers)
        print("Center cosine matrix:")
        print(np.round(centers@centers.T,2))

print("\nCommon output directions of L0H4 and their linear coupling to later QK weights")
u,s,_=la.svd(B[4],full_matrices=False)

import numpy as np
import scipy.linalg as la
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

threadpool_limits(4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=160)
d=384
P=np.eye(d)-np.ones((d,d))/d

Q=[];K=[];V=[];O=[];A=[];B=[]
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
    Q.append((W["W_q.0"][sl]*g)@P)
    K.append((W["W_k.0"][sl]*g)@P)
    V.append((W["W_v.0"][sl]*g)@P)
    O.append(np.asarray(W["W_o.0"][:,sl],dtype=float))
    A.append(Q[-1].T@K[-1])
    B.append(O[-1]@V[-1])

print("L0 head value spectra: raw, and gain-scaled")
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
    print("H",j,"raw",la.svdvals(W["W_v.0"][sl].astype(float))[:36])

# Position-like weight subspace: dominant left/right singular directions of the two rotational QK matrices.

print("\nJoint rotational-QK spectrum",ps[:40])
for r in (16,24,32):
    U=pvt[:r].T
    print("Rotational subspace rank",r)
    for j in range(6):
        _,sv,vt=la.svd(V[j],full_matrices=False)
        print("H",j,"V_energy",round(float(la.norm(V[j]@U)**2/la.norm(V[j])**2),3),

    _,_,a=la.svd(V[1],full_matrices=False)
    _,_,b=la.svd(V[5],full_matrices=False)
    print("rank",r,"cosines",la.svdvals(a[:r]@b[:r].T))

print("\nMLP duplicate-feature components, and backward linear coupling through the L0 heads")
f=(np.asarray(W["W_fc.0"],dtype=float)*W["ln2_w.0"])@P
fn=la.norm(f,axis=1)
unit=f/fn[:,None]
cos=unit@unit.T
n,labels=connected_components(csr_matrix(cos>.90),directed=False)
groups=sorted([np.flatnonzero(labels==i) for i in range(n)],key=lambda ix:(-len(ix),int(ix[0])))
_,_,vt=la.svd(np.vstack([V[1],V[5]]),full_matrices=False)
T=vt[:30].T
for ix in groups:

    c=unit[ix].mean(axis=0); c/=la.norm(c)

    print("feature",int(ix[0]),"size",len(ix),"direct_char_subspace",round(direct,3),

import numpy as np

from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=160)
d=384
P=np.eye(d)-np.ones((d,d))/d
g=np.asarray(W["ln1_w.0"],float)
B=[];VV=[]
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
    v=(W["W_v.0"][sl]*g)@P
    VV.append(v)
    B.append(np.asarray(W["W_o.0"][:,sl],float)@v)
_,_,vt=la.svd(np.vstack([VV[1],VV[5]]),full_matrices=False)
T=vt[:30].T
F=(np.asarray(W["W_fc.0"],float)*W["ln2_w.0"])@P
fn=la.norm(F,axis=1)
U=F/fn[:,None]
n,labels=connected_components(csr_matrix(U@U.T>.90),directed=False)
records=[]
excluded=set()
for label in range(n):
    ix=np.flatnonzero(labels==label)
    if len(ix)<2: continue
    c=U[ix].mean(axis=0);c/=la.norm(c)
    if la.norm(c@T)>.4:
        records.append((int(ix[0]),ix,c))
        excluded.update(ix.tolist())
records.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
C=np.array([r[2] for r in records])
ids=[r[0] for r in records]

D=la.pinv(C)

# Only products of trained weight matrices and their derived directions:
# no LayerNorm evaluation, attention computation, or ReLU.
X=F@D
Y=F@B[5]@D
Z=F@B[1]@D
for name,M in [("direct",X),("via_L0H5_OV",Y),("via_L0H1_OV",Z)]:
    spread=M-M.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    purity=np.sort(spread,axis=1)[:,-1]/(la.norm(spread,axis=1)+1e-30)

print("\nPer-feature coefficient strength and duplicate-component geometry")

    print(fid,"copies",len(ix),"input_norm",round(float(np.median(fn[ix])),3),
          "output_norm",round(float(la.norm(W["W_proj.0"][:,ix])),3),
          "direct_column_norm",round(float(la.norm(X[:,k])),3),
          "previous_column_norm",round(float(la.norm(Y[:,k])),3))

for cutoff in (.35,.45,.55):
    M=X-X.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    N=Y-Y.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
    px=M.max(axis=1)/(la.norm(M,axis=1)+1e-30)
    py=N.max(axis=1)/(la.norm(N,axis=1)+1e-30)
    sel=(px>cutoff)&(py>cutoff)
    sel[list(excluded)]=False
    a=M.argmax(axis=1); b=N.argmax(axis=1)
    counts=np.zeros((len(C),len(C)))
    for i in np.flatnonzero(sel):
        counts[b[i],a[i]]+=1
    total=counts.sum()
    print("\nWeight-feature pairing graph cutoff",cutoff,"neurons",int(total))
    print("Largest predecessor/current pair counts:",
          [(ids[i],ids[j],int(counts[i,j])) for i,j in
           [np.unravel_index(t,counts.shape) for t in np.argsort(-counts.ravel())[:30]] if counts[i,j]>0])
    print("Diagonal counts:",[(ids[i],int(counts[i,i])) for i in range(len(C)) if counts[i,i]>0])
    sym=counts+counts.T
    deg=sym.sum(axis=1)
    S=sym/np.sqrt(np.maximum(deg[:,None]*deg[None,:],1))
    ev,evec=la.eigh(S)

    cross=sym[np.ix_(part,~part)].sum()*2/(sym.sum()+1e-30)
    print("Normalized graph smallest eigenvalues",ev[:5],"spectral cut fraction",round(float(cross),3))
    print("Spectral partition", [ids[i] for i in np.flatnonzero(part)],
          [ids[i] for i in np.flatnonzero(~part)])

from collections import Counter
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)

Q=[];K=[];V=[];B=[];A=[]

T=vt[:30].T

for label in range(n):
    ix=np.flatnonzero(labels==label)
    if len(ix)<2: continue
    c=U[ix].mean(axis=0);c/=la.norm(c)
    o=W["W_proj.0"][:,ix].astype(float).mean(axis=1);o/=la.norm(o)
    rec=(int(ix[0]),len(ix),c,o)
    (char if la.norm(c@T)>.4 else other).append(rec)
char.sort(key=lambda r:r[0]);other.sort(key=lambda r:r[0])
ci=np.array([r[2] for r in char]); co=np.array([r[3] for r in char])
print("Other duplicate-feature groups: closest input and output character-like groups")
for fid,count,c,o in other:
    si=ci@c;so=co@o
    ii=np.argsort(-np.abs(si))[:3];oi=np.argsort(-np.abs(so))[:3]
    print("group",fid,"size",count,"input_output_cos",round(float(c@o),3),
          "input_matches",[(char[i][0],round(float(si[i]),3)) for i in ii],

print("\nRotation-phase consistency: H1 compared with integer multiples of H5's phase")
ev,vl,vr=la.eig(A[5],left=True,right=True)
data=[]
for ix in np.argsort(-np.abs(ev)):
    if ev[ix].imag<=1e-5 or abs(ev[ix])<0.8: continue
    r=vr[:,ix];ll=vl[:,ix]
    z=(ll.conj()@A[1]@r)/(ll.conj()@r)
    align=abs(np.vdot(A[1]@r,r))/(la.norm(A[1]@r)*la.norm(r)+1e-30)
    data.append((abs(ev[ix]),np.angle(ev[ix]),np.angle(z),align))
print("Rows: H5 magnitude, H5 phase, H1 projected phase, collinearity")
print(np.array(data))
for skip in (0,1):
    rows=data[skip:]
    print("Exclude largest mode pair:",bool(skip))
    for multiple in (1,2,3,4):
        scores=[np.cos(b-multiple*a) for mag,a,b,align in rows]
        weights=[mag*align for mag,a,b,align in rows]
        print("phase multiple",multiple,"weighted cosine",round(float(np.average(scores,weights=weights)),3))
